title: Nepalese authorities ban rallies and mass meetings in Kathmandu prior to the first meeting of the 1st Nepalese Constituent Assembly which is expected to declare Nepal a republic.
text: The first Nepalese Constituent Assembly was a unicameral body of 601 members that served from May 28, 2008, to May 28, 2012. It was formed as a result of the first Constituent Assembly election held on April 10, 2008.

title: The Nepalese Constituent Assembly meets for the first time after the 2008 Nepalese Constituent Assembly election and votes to abolish the monarchy and establish a republic.
text: Constituent Assembly elections were held in Nepal on 10 April 2008, having been postponed from earlier dates of 7 June 2007 and 22 November 2007. The Constituent Assembly was planned to draft a new constitution and therefore decide, amongst other things, on the issue of federalism.

title: The last King of Nepal Gyanendra departs from Narayanhiti Palace for the last time after Nepal is declared to be a republic.
text: Shree Panch Gyanendra Bir Bikram Shah Dev is the former King of Nepal and the last monarch of Kingdom of Nepal. He ascended the throne on 4 June 2001 following the royal massacre and reigned until 28 May 2008, when the monarchy was abolished and the democratic republic was proclaimed.

title: Nepal's presidential election concludes with Ram Baran Yadav winning with a majority.
text: Dr. Ram Baran Yadav is a Nepalese politician and physician who served as the first president of Nepal from 23 July 2008 to 29 October 2015, following the declaration of republic in 2008.

title: ९ अप्रैल- नेपाल में संविधान सभा के लिए मतदान हुआ।

title: २४ जून - नेपाल के प्रधानमंत्री गिरिजा प्रसाद कोइराला ने अपने पद से इस्तीफ़ा दिया।

title: कागबेनी
text: कागबेनी २०६४ पुष २७ मा प्रदर्शनमा आएको एक नेपाली चलचित्र हो, जुन विलियम वार्क ज्याकोब्सको सन् १९०२ को डरलाग्दो लघुकथा द मङ्किज पजमा आधारित थियो। कागबेनी भूषण दाहालको निर्देशनमा बनेको चलचित्र हो। चलचित्रको नाम मुक्तिनाथबाट दुई घण्टाको पैदल दूरीमा रहेको कालीगण्डकी उपत्यकाको पर्यटकीय स्थल कागबेनीबाट लिइएको हो। कागबेनीलाई नेपाली चलचित्रलाई हेर्ने दृष्टिकोणमा परिवर्तन ल्याउने चलचित्र मानिन्छ, किनकि यो नेपालको पहिलो सफल…

title: सानो संसार
text: सानो संसार आलोक नेम्वाङद्वारा निर्देशित सन् २००८ को नेपाली प्रेमप्रसङ्गयुक्त हास्य चलचित्र हो। चलचित्रमा विशाल स्टार कास्ट छ, जसमा नीर शाह र नयाँ कलाकार महेश शाक्य (लोकप्रिय कर्मा), जीवन लुइटेल र नम्रता श्रेष्ठ शामिल छन्। सानो संसार निर्देशक आलोक नेम्वाङद्वारा निर्देशित पहिलो चलचित्र र 'कागबेनी' पछि बनेको दोस्रो नेपाली एचडी चलचित्र हो। यो चलचित्र कोरियाली चलचित्र 'माई स्यासी गर्ल' र अङ्ग्रेजी भाषाको चलचित्र 'यु ह्…

title: म तिमी बिना मरिहाल्छु
text: म तिमी बिना मरिहाल्छु एक सैन्य व्यक्तिसँग सम्बन्धित एक नेपाली चलचित्र हो जसले आफ्नो ज्यान जोखिममा पारेर भएपनि देशलाई बचाउनको लागि ठूलो भूमिका खेलेको यस चलचित्रमा प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ। यस चलचित्रमा भुवन केसी, झरना थापा र सुस्मिता केसी प्रमुख पात्रको रूपमा रहेका छन्। चलचित्र २०६५ सालमा सार्वजनिक गरिएको थियोे।

title: देश देखि विदेश
text: देश देखि विदेश २०६४ पुष १७ मा, प्रदर्शनमा आएको एक नेपाली कथानक चलचित्र हो। यस चलचित्रमा निखिल उप्रेती, दिलीप रायमाझी, ऋचा घिमिरे, प्रेरणा शर्मा र दमन रूपाखेतीलाई मुख्य भूमिका देख्न सकिन्छ।

title: Kagbeni
text: Kagbeni is a 2008 Nepali movie, loosely based on W. W. Jacobs's 1902 horror short story The Monkey's Paw. Kagbeni is the directorial debut of Bhusan Dahal.

title: Sano Sansar
text: Sano Sansar is a 2008 Nepali romantic comedy film directed by Alok Nembang. The film has a massive star cast which includes Neer Shah and newcomers Mahesh Shakya (popularly known Karma), Jiwan Luitel and Namrata Shrestha.

title: Desh Dekhi Bidesh
text: Desh Dekhi Bidesh, shortened as DDB, is a movie made in Nepal which was released in 2008. It was directed by Narendra Thapa, with a script by Subash Singh Basnet and starring Nikhil Upreti and Prerana Sharma in the lead roles, and with Dilip Rayamajhi, Richa Ghimire, Daman Rupakheti, Anju Lama, Nirajan Sigdel, and others.

title: Ma Timi Bina Marihalchhu
text: Ma Timi Bina Marihalchhu is 2008 film about a soldier who risks his life to save his country. This film features Bhuwan K.C., Jharana Thapa and Sushmita K.C. in the lead roles.
